records.rationale: Network surveillance and receiving element messages are conventional monitoring, but the text's claim that analysis determines outage causes gives no method, leaving an unexplained potentially AI-dependent function.

records.rationale: Work-request loading, scheduling, status, and productivity tracking are conventional dispatch functions, but estimating job duration and prioritizing requests have no described method and leave an uncertain prediction/decision function.
